description.value: A large, popular family campground on the shore of Nicola Lake in a hot, dry Ponderosa pine and bunchgrass landscape, offering swimming, fishing, boating, and windsurfing; gets very busy in summer and sudden windstorms can make the lake hazardous.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Monck Park is an active provincial campground on Nicola Lake with 120 sites (corroborated by OSM capacity tag). The website prominently features a 'Book camping' call-to-action and a 'Reservation policies' section, confirming reservations are accepted. An on-site store is referenced ('Major credit cards are accepted at the gatehouse and store'), supporting a food-nearby determination; all other optional amenities are absent from both the website and OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Monck Provincial Campground' but BC Parks website consistently refers to it as 'Monck Park' — minor name discrepancy.
No civic address in OSM record or on the website page fetched.
Phone number could not be cross-verified from the fetched website content; contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Operator email (parkinquiries@telus.net) appears to be a generic Brandywine park-inquiries address rather than a Monck-specific contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC Parks provincial campground with 120 sites on Nicola Lake; confirmed active with online booking. A clear and useful listing for touring cyclists travelling through the Thompson-Okanagan corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag sanitary_dump_station=yes is noted but not a WWC-listed amenity. The store on-site may stock camping supplies including fuel, but no explicit evidence was found.

wow_evidence: large, popular family campground on the shore of Nicola Lake... offering swimming, fishing, boating
